Block Templates

id:          CommentPinShowcase
name:        Avatar-first annotations
description: Caller-positioned comment pins over media and in a content margin. Every coordinate maps to the pin's logical bottom-start corner. The selected group caps its participants at three circles (two Avatars plus an ellipsis) and ends with its total and an accent unread dot; the unread margin pin shows the dot too. Other pins dim without becoming disabled, activating the selected pin again clears the selection, and no pin dims while nothing is selected.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          ListInputBudgetAllocation
name:        Budget allocation
description: Mixed control types in one record: a team Selector in a proportional column beside a percentage NumberInput in a fixed 132px column. Each team can appear once (a record error), the rows must total 100% (a list error), and Add stops at four teams.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentsShowcase
name:        Comments panel
description: A working Comments panel: threads with replies, reactions, edit history, controlled typing with hidden seen metadata, inline comments, a non-interrupting unread-reply reveal, an agent reply still being written, a resolved thread, a comment that failed to send, activity events, and earlier comments to load. Post, reply, react, edit, delete, and resolve; the host updates the controlled comments.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          DialogHeroHeaderShowcase
name:        DialogHeroHeader
description: An onboarding dialog with full-bleed artwork and an overlaid close button.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          ListInputFamilyMembers
name:        Family member declaration
description: Three simple fields per record, the recommended ceiling: a full legal name, a relationship Selector, and a DateInput in a fixed 176px column. Order is immaterial, so the list is not reorderable. At 640px or narrower each record stacks its fields with repeated labels.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentPinInMargin
name:        Host-owned placement
description: A caller-positioned CommentPin in a document margin. The host maps its anchor to the pin's logical bottom-start corner and owns the surrounding layout; the pin owns its compact interactive surface. Activating the pin toggles its selected state.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentThreadInPopover
name:        In a popover
description: Open one thread from a passage in a Popover with no padding. The thread owns the Popover's dismissal through `onDismiss`, so turn the Popover's light and Escape dismissal off: a press outside or Escape closes the thread, but the first one over an unsaved reply shakes it and keeps the draft.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          EmojiPickerInPopover
name:        In a popover
description: Open the picker from an emoji button in a Popover with no padding. Leave the Popover's autofocus on: it lands in the search field, so typing searches right away.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentsInline
name:        Inline comments
description: A realistic Markdown document review with highlighted passages synchronized to a Comments side panel. Selecting an unannotated passage starts a quoted thread; replies and resolution update host-owned data.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          EmojiPickerShowcase
name:        Inline picker
description: An emoji picker inline in a Card: search by name or keyword, move with the arrow keys, and pick; the last pick shows above it.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentsInCard
name:        Inside a card
description: Set container="card" on a card parent: threads become divider-bounded Sections, so cards never nest, and the composer docks at the bottom of the card.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          ListInputMailingList
name:        Mailing list
description: A one-column list that starts empty, shows the empty state with Add still available, and stops adding at six addresses. A repeated address is a record error, a malformed address is a field error after blur, and removing the last address shows the required-list error.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentThreadShowcase
name:        Margin comment
description: One comment thread in a Card beside a document: it quotes its passage, opens on a press into its replies and reply composer, and resolves.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          CommentComposerShowcase
name:        New comment
description: A comment composer quoting the passage it comments on: type, add an emoji, and post with Enter or Post.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          ListInputShowcase
name:        Tag options
description: A reorderable tag editor. Each record pairs a color Selector with a label TextInput; drag a grip or use the keyboard to reorder. Validation sits at the narrowest useful level: an empty label after blur is a field error, a disallowed color and label pair is a record error, and fewer than five tags is a list error.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

id:          DiffViewerShowcase
name:        Unified diff from a patch
description: A patch parsed with parseUnifiedDiff and rendered in unified or split view. Clicking a line number selects that line and opens an annotation row under it, the way a review comment would appear.
package:     @astryxdesign/lab

Usage

npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <id> [target-path]     Scaffold page or block
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template <id> --skeleton        Layout reference
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type block    List only blocks
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --package <pkg> List from one package
npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --cdn                 CDN starter page, no build step
